items.excerpt: Canva launched Canva Code 2.0, a major upgrade to its AI-powered coding tool that turns plain-language prompts into interactive websites, apps and experiences — now available to every user, including free accounts.

The primary consumer of a design system has changed species: tokens are no longer written for human engineers but parsed by AI models, reframing design tokens as prompts for machine-driven UI generation.

An experiment takes generative UI from blueprint to a working e-commerce funnel — five personas, a live model in the loop, 200 simulated shoppers — and argues page-level generative UI is closer to production than it looks.
DEVELOP3D talks with Novineer CEO Ali Tamijani about the startup's AI-driven reverse engineering and generative design tools for additive manufacturing and product design.
An indie Star Trek fan-film team explains how AI-assisted VFX could finally solve one of visual effects' biggest and most tedious production headaches for small creative teams.
As AI absorbs the screen, the design work doesn't vanish — it falls one layer down, reframing AX (agent/AI experience) as an orchestration layer that becomes the designer's new surface.
As AI democratizes execution, strategic thinking and taste become the true competitive advantage — an argument for the death of design-by-committee in the age of AI.
How chat, voice and agentic AI are rewriting the first principles of UX design as the traditional visual interface dissolves into conversation and autonomous agents.
